senses.gloss: c. (Inf. Nif. of עָלַם) being unknown, esp. (with ref. to Lev. IV to V) unconsciousness, forgetfulness as the cause of a transgression.
units: <cite ref="Shevuot 26a:28">Shebu. 26ᵃ</cite> <he>ה׳ שבועה</he> forgetting that he had sworn; <he>ה׳ חפץ</he> forgetting the subject of the oath.
<cite ref="Shabbat 70b:3">Sabb. 70ᵇ</cite> <he>ה׳ שבת</he> unconsciousness of its being the Sabbath day; <he>ה׳ מלאכות</he> of the sinful nature of those labors.

<cite ref="Shabbat 70b:3">Ib.</cite> <he>אם עשאן … בה׳ אחד</he> if he did all the forbidden labors in one state of unconsciousness (without being reminded between); Y. ib. III, 9ᵇ top <he>בה׳ אחת</he>. Ib. I, 2ᵇ <he>בעלם אחד</he> (interch. with <he>בהעלם</he>); <cite ref="Bava Batra 55b:5">B. Bath. 55ᵇ</cite> <he>בה׳</he> (Ms. H. <he>בעלם</he>); <cite ref="Mishnah Keritot 4:2">Ker. IV, 2</cite> (<cite ref="Keritot 17b:37">17ᵇ</cite>) <he>בה׳ אחת</he>; <cite ref="Mishnah Keritot 3:2">Ker. III, 2</cite> <he>בה׳ אחד</he>. Sifra Vayikra, Ḥobah, Par. 1, ch. I; a. fr.—Pl. <he>הֵעָלֵימוֹת</he>. Y. Sabb. l. c. <he>בשני ה׳</he> in two discontinuous states of forgetfulness. Y. Shebu. I, 32ᵈ top <he>כמה ידיעות וה׳</he> many moments of consciousness and intervening forgetfulness.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 7:5:1">Y. Snh. VII, 24ᶜ</cite> top; a. e.—Usu. <he>הַעֲלָמוֹת</he> (fr. <cite ref="E00718"><he>הַעֲלָמָה</he></cite>, v. <cite ref="E00718">next w.</cite>), or <he>הֵעָלֵמוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Shabbat 80a:5">Sabb. 80ᵃ</cite> <he>בשתי ה׳</he>; <cite ref="Keritot 17a:21">Ker. 17ᵃ</cite>; B. Bath. l. c. <he>בשני ה׳</he>.

<cite ref="Tosefta Keritot 3:2">Tosef. Ker. III, 2</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Keritot 3:7">7</cite> <he>בשני ה׳</he>; a. fr.—[<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 9:21">Midr. Till. to Ps. IX, 1</cite> <he>הָעֲלָמוֹת</he>, v. <cite ref="P00821"><he>עֶלֶם</he></cite>.]
